messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] billing-metering: elevated late-window emits detected for eu-west-3. token counts lagging vs host logs, overage flags spike. severity: P2

ops-oncall: oncall here, ack. any customer impact seen yet? :eyes:

maya: checking. quick recon — kafka consumer lag ~12-18m for emitter-stream-eu, retry counts x2. shadow ledger shows catch-up but delayed writes.

liam: logs show emitter worker restarts around 03:10 UTC, stacktrace points to OOM in emitter-processor-3. probably causes replay/backpressure.

sam: can we enable backup emitter path? I'll start switch to emitter-fallback-1 now.

carmen: FYI billing-recon query shows ~0.8% of tokens delayed >1h; most customers unaffected but a couple of high-usage tenants have overage flags. compiling list.

ops-oncall: good. maya, can you run a quick delta report to identify customers with flag false positives so we can suppress alerts?

maya: running: ```SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) as delayed FROM shadow_ledger WHERE processed_at > event_time + interval '1 hour' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY delayed desc LIMIT 10;``` will post results in 2m.

liam: meanwhile scaling emitter-processor to +2 pods and increasing JVM heap on emitter-processor-3. triggering redeploy.

sam: emitter-fallback switched, traffic shifted. monitoring for TTLs and duplicate suppression.

maya: query results: tenant: acme-corp (2.4M delayed), bizly (450k), some smaller ones. adding to thread with action items.

carmen: recommend suppressing overage flags for those tenants until backfill completes. ops-oncall please approve.

ops-oncall: approve suppression for acme-corp and bizly only. add audit entry and retention note. proceed with email template for postmortem.

sam: suppressions applied. sending internal notice to support to hold customer replies.

liam: emitter-processor-3 redeployed, heap up, restarts stabilized. kafka lag down to ~1-2m.

maya: backfill job started for delayed records. ETA ~ 45m for acme-corp full reconciliation.

ops-oncall: assign PM & CS for customer comms post-recon. logging incident for billing team. keeping P2 until backfill complete.

carmen: noted. will draft customer-safe language: "we observed delayed usage reporting causing temporary overage flags; no billing changes applied; reconciliation in progress." will share.

incident-bot: incident updated: state=mitigating, severity=P2, runbook=emitter-restart-backfill

ops-oncall: thanks team. keep updates short. ping when backfill done or if any customer escalations.
